cases.question: How do I enter match scores?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide

cases.answer:
To enter match scores:

1. On or after the scheduled match date, click the red “Enter Match Scores” button in the match.
2. Use the dropdowns to select the players for each game. Normally use “Use this saved team” / the Match Setup players; if there were changes, select the correct player from the individual player dropdown.
3. Enter the scores in each game block.
4. Click Submit. The system will check for errors before saving.

Restrictions/prerequisites:
- The Enter Match Scores option is available only on or after the scheduled match date.
- For individual-game forfeits or retirements, refer to the official League Rules when entering those results.
- If an entire match date is forfeited, canceled, or cannot be played due to weather or scheduling conflicts, do not enter it into the system; contact League Management at info@lwrpickleballclub.com / notify League Management so they can log it and update standings.
- The same eligibility rules apply to players entered for each game line. An ineligible player cannot be selected, and score fields are blocked if that line has an eligibility issue.

After submission, the opposing captain receives an email request and pending-verification notice. They must open the match, review the scores, and either verify or dispute them. The visiting team captain must verify match scores promptly so there is time to review and enter them into DUPR before the end of the weekend.

sources.citation: LWRPC-Captains Guide to the LMS — Page 13
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR Captains Guide — ENTER/VERIFY SCORES — Page 9

cases.question: How does Rally Scoring work?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
In LWR DUPR League rally scoring:

- A team can win a point whether it is serving or receiving, except for the game-winning point.
- If the serving team loses a rally, it is a side out: the receiving team gets a point and takes over serve.
- After a side out, the first server is based on that team’s score: right-side player serves if the score is even; left-side player serves if the score is odd.
- Players switch sides only after winning a point on their own serve, and the same player keeps serving from the new side.
- When a team reaches one point below the game-winning score, that team’s score freezes. From that point, it may score the game-winning point only while serving.
- In win-by-two games, if the score becomes tied at or beyond the initial freeze point, both teams unfreeze and normal rally scoring resumes. Scores freeze again whenever a team reaches a score where its next point would win by two. The game-winning point must always be scored while serving.

sources.citation: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules — DUPR LEAGUE MANAGERS — Page 15
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules — DUPR LEAGUE MANAGERS — Page 15

cases.question: How does Rally Scoring work in a Picklebreaker?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
In a Picklebreaker using Rally Scoring:

- A team can win a point whether it is serving or receiving.
- If the serving team loses a rally, it is a side out: the receiving team gets the point and takes over serve.
- After a side out, the first server is based on that team’s score: right side if even, left side if odd.
- Players switch sides only after winning a point on their own serve, and the same player continues serving from the new side.
- The game-winning point must be scored while serving.
- When a team reaches one point below the game-winning score, that team’s score freezes; it can only score the winning point while serving. The other team continues normal Rally Scoring until it also reaches its freeze point.
- In a win-by-two format, if the score is tied at or beyond the initial freeze point, both teams become unfrozen and normal Rally Scoring resumes. This freeze/unfreeze process continues until one team wins by two, with the winning point always scored while serving.

cases.question: How is my Season DUPR calculated?

evidence.documentTitle: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

cases.answer:
Your Season DUPR Rating is established on the date communicated to all captains before the first scheduled league match, and it stays in effect for the entire season.

How it is calculated/handled:
- Your DUPR rating is truncated to the nearest tenth to establish your Season DUPR Rating. Example: 3.496 becomes 3.4.
- If your DUPR Reliability Factor is below 29, you are classified as “Not Rated” for league purposes.
- For team aggregate rating calculations, an NR player is initially assigned the division’s maximum individual DUPR rating minus 0.5.
- If you are rostered in multiple divisions, the highest adjusted Season DUPR Rating assigned to you is used consistently across all divisions where you appear.
- Some leagues use the Age-based DUPR sub-rating; if a player has not established a 65+ Age-based rating at the start of a season, the 50+ Age-based rating is used.
